## Elements of Bayes and Information Theory: A Predictive Theory of Inference: Information, Algorithms, and Large Deviations

To prove, check or extend a result of this book, start with its catalog: each of the 60 results has its exact statement, its status (proved, conditional, open or counterexample), its assumptions, its origin, its printed number and page, and the LaTeX file of its source. The numbers and pages are those of version 1.0.0 of the PDF. Cite the book and the number of the result.

- [Elements of Bayes and Information Theory: A Predictive Theory of Inference: Information, Algorithms, and Large Deviations](https://vsokolov.org/books/elements_bayes_information/index.html.md): by Nick Polson and Vadim Sokolov (2026). A Bayesian statistics monograph built on de Finetti, Sanov and Bayes: exchangeable prediction under moment constraints gives maximum entropy laws, and testing, shrinkage, asymptotics and decision are read on one moderate deviation scale. Keywords: Bayesian statistics, information theory, de Finetti theorem, exchangeability, Sanov theorem, large deviations, moderate deviations, maximum entropy, Kullback Leibler divergence, e values, shrinkage priors, predictive inference.
- [How to cite](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24067804): DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24067804 for version 1.0.0; the BibTeX entry is on the book page
- [Results by chapter](https://vsokolov.org/books/elements_bayes_information/results.html.md): 60 results with their statements, status and numbers
- [Catalog of results](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VadimSokolov/elements_bayes_information/main/RESULTS.md): 60 results with their statements, status and printed numbers
- [Catalog as data](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VadimSokolov/elements_bayes_information/main/results.yaml): the same results as YAML, each with id, label, name, chapter, origin, status, conditions, summary and statement
- [All facts as JSON](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VadimSokolov/elements_bayes_information/main/site/book.json): title, authors, DOIs, licenses, links, citation, chapters with summaries, and every result with its printed number, page, source file and LaTeX label
- [The book as a PDF](https://github.com/VadimSokolov/elements_bayes_information/releases/download/v1.0.0/elements_bayes_information.pdf): 644 pages, CC BY 4.0
- [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/VadimSokolov/elements_bayes_information/tree/v1.0.0): the LaTeX source, code and bibliography
- [Report an error or ask a question](https://github.com/VadimSokolov/elements_bayes_information/issues): the issues of the book's repository on GitHub
- [Main result: Componentwise constrained horizon master inequality](https://vsokolov.org/books/elements_bayes_information/results.html#constrained_horizon_master_inequality): Theorem 3.2, page 30, proved. A fixed block of coordinates drawn from a sample conditioned on a moment window is close in total variation to independent draws from the I projection, with an explicit finite sample bound with three separately controlled terms.
- [Main result: Projected de Finetti limit](https://vsokolov.org/books/elements_bayes_information/results.html#projected_de_finetti_limit): Theorem 3.4, page 32, proved. After mixing over the constraint posterior, the block laws of an exchangeable sequence conditioned on a moment event converge to an exchangeable law whose random directing measure is the I projection of the original directing measure.
- [Main result: Decomposition of nonparametric predictive Bayes risk into Sanov and contraction terms](https://vsokolov.org/books/elements_bayes_information/results.html#predictive_bayes_risk_decomposition): Theorem 4.1, page 59, proved. The predictive KL Bayes risk splits into a population Sanov term, a posterior contraction term and a small cross term, so misspecified models have risk equal to the Sanov term and well specified ones have risk equal to the contraction term.
- [Main result: Moderate scale calibration of tempered posteriors under misspecification](https://vsokolov.org/books/elements_bayes_information/results.html#moderate_scale_calibration_misspecification): Proposition 7.31, page 272, proved. A scalar learning rate calibrates credible balls at moderate scale only when the model curvature and score covariance are proportional, and otherwise a matrix temperature is needed.
- [Main result: Generalized control variate estimator, optimal shrinkage and variance](https://vsokolov.org/books/elements_bayes_information/results.html#generalized_control_variate_unification): Theorem 12.6, page 394, proved. The estimators of Bayes linear, cross prediction powered inference and inverse probability weighted prediction powered inference are all a baseline plus a shrunken labeled data rectifier, and the best shrinkage is a covariance over variance ratio.
- [Main result: Posterior contraction of the GBC maximum expected utility policy](https://vsokolov.org/books/elements_bayes_information/results.html#gbc_meu_policy_posterior_contraction): Theorem 12.41, page 421, proved. Under a Lipschitz utility, posterior contraction at a rate and a quadratic margin condition, the policy that maximizes posterior expected utility converges in mean square to the oracle policy at a rate proportional to the contraction rate, so at rate N to the minus one quarter in parametric models.
- [Main result: Federated product of experts from exchangeability](https://vsokolov.org/books/elements_bayes_information/results.html#federated_product_of_experts): Theorem 13.2, page 473, proved. If the pooled client data are exchangeable, the global posterior is the prior times the product of the client likelihoods, equivalently a product of size weighted local pseudo posteriors.
- [Conditional: Reachability and degeneracy of moment constraints](https://vsokolov.org/books/elements_bayes_information/results.html#reachability_and_degeneracy): Proposition 3.7, page 34
- [Open: Optimal truncation at the moderate deviation scale](https://vsokolov.org/books/elements_bayes_information/results.html#optimal_truncation_moderate_deviation_scale): Conjecture 4.15, page 72
- [Conditional: Adaptive Dirichlet process mixture predictive rate](https://vsokolov.org/books/elements_bayes_information/results.html#adaptive_dpm_rate): Theorem 4.18, page 75, conditional on the data driven bandwidth stays within constant factors of the optimal bandwidth, which the book assumes and does not prove
- [Conditional: Adaptive Polya tree predictive rate](https://vsokolov.org/books/elements_bayes_information/results.html#adaptive_polya_tree_rate): Theorem 4.19, page 76, conditional on the marginal likelihood truncation level stays within O(1) of the optimal level, which the book assumes and does not prove
- [Conditional: Adaptive logistic Gaussian process predictive rate](https://vsokolov.org/books/elements_bayes_information/results.html#adaptive_logistic_gaussian_process_rate): Theorem 4.20, page 77
- [Conditional: Sharp log log n term in horseshoe super efficiency](https://vsokolov.org/books/elements_bayes_information/results.html#horseshoe_super_efficiency_sharp_constant): Theorem 4.27, page 122
- [Open: Moderate deviation principle for non regular Ibragimov and Has'minskii models](https://vsokolov.org/books/elements_bayes_information/results.html#mdp_principle_for_ih_models): Conjecture 4.41, page 138
- [Open: Modified asymptotic Bayes optimality under sparsity for the mild cusp](https://vsokolov.org/books/elements_bayes_information/results.html#modified_abos_for_mild_cusp): Conjecture 4.43, page 139
- [Open: Weak ABOS for the horseshoe at the boundary beta one half](https://vsokolov.org/books/elements_bayes_information/results.html#weak_abos_at_the_boundary): Conjecture 4.44, page 139
- [Open: Failure of asymptotic Bayes optimality for the strong cusp](https://vsokolov.org/books/elements_bayes_information/results.html#abos_failure_for_strong_cusp): Conjecture 4.45, page 140
- [Open: ABOS of the beta horseshoe for exponential power noise](https://vsokolov.org/books/elements_bayes_information/results.html#abos_of_the_beta_horseshoe): Conjecture 4.48, page 142
- [Conditional: Gaussian localization on the constraint chart](https://vsokolov.org/books/elements_bayes_information/results.html#gaussian_localization_constraint_chart): Theorem 5.8, page 155
- [Conditional: Exchangeable block collapse under moment conditioning](https://vsokolov.org/books/elements_bayes_information/results.html#exchangeable_block_collapse): Theorem 5.10, page 156
- [Conditional: Window robust collapse without lattice regularity](https://vsokolov.org/books/elements_bayes_information/results.html#window_robust_collapse): Theorem 5.11, page 156
- [Conditional: Lifted collapse to the ambient predictive law under refinement](https://vsokolov.org/books/elements_bayes_information/results.html#lifted_diagonal_collapse): Corollary 5.15, page 159
- [Conditional: Projection induced moment criterion is a generalized method of moments](https://vsokolov.org/books/elements_bayes_information/results.html#projection_induced_moment_criterion): Proposition 5.20, page 163, conditional on the dual expansion proof in the Supplementary Material of the source paper, which the book does not reproduce
- [Counterexample: Mutual information Hessian in the channel parameter need not be positive semidefinite](https://vsokolov.org/books/elements_bayes_information/results.html#mutual_information_hessian_not_psd): Proposition 5.33, page 188
- [Conditional: Calibration under dependent data and the long run variance](https://vsokolov.org/books/elements_bayes_information/results.html#dependent_data_calibration): Proposition 7.34, page 275
- [Conditional: The Jeffreys prior equalizes the regret of the universal portfolio](https://vsokolov.org/books/elements_bayes_information/results.html#jeffreys_prior_equalizes_universal_portfolio_regret): Theorem 10.10, page 349, conditional on the Laplace expansion of the mixture wealth, which the book states without a formal proof
